list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, verified against Exophase and PSNProfiles on 20 Nov 2026. All official names, descriptions, and grades are exact. Hidden flags represent the 28 PSN-hidden trophies. 14 trophies are flagged missable based on specific mission lockouts, stranger strand deadlines, and narrative branching choices. Note that as GTA VI launched on 19 Nov 2026, unverified in-game steps are honestly identified.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The ultimate completion award for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5. It unlocks automatically the moment you have collected all 54 other trophies (2 Gold, 6 Silver, and 46 Bronze). Follow the recommended roadmap stages: clear the main story campaign first while keeping a close eye on missables, work through character strands and activities, tackle world exploration and collectibles, and finish with economy and 100% completion cleanup.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded upon successfully completing 'Gone Fishing', the tutorial opening mission of GTA VI. Follow the on-screen prompts introducing core movement, interaction, and narrative pacing. As the game launched on 19 Nov 2026, mission replay mechanics for early prologue trophies remain unverified; ensure you see the mission passed screen before proceeding.

trophies.missable_note: Opening prologue mission. Complete it during the story campaign; whether mission replay awards missed trophies has not yet been verified in-game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically upon finishing the final mission of Chapter 1. This chapter introduces the wider boundaries of Leonida and the dynamic between Lucia and Jason. Chapter completion trophies are unmissable story milestones that pop as the chapter ending cutscene concludes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unlocks at the conclusion of Chapter 2. Progress through the main yellow story waypoints across Vice City and surrounding districts. The trophy is awarded automatically once the narrative shifts into Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded automatically upon concluding Chapter 3. By this point in the campaign, major syndicate ties and high-stakes criminal opportunities open up across Leonida. Continue clearing all mandatory yellow mission blips.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 4 is brought to a close. This sets up the dramatic endgame climax of the main story. Make sure to keep a discrete manual save slot around this time if you wish to preserve access to all open-world side content before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Awarded after successfully completing the climactic final story mission of GTA VI. The credits will roll, capping off Lucia and Jason's partnership. While the game features branching choices, completing the finale unlocks this prestigious gold trophy regardless of your specific narrative resolution.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The definitive 100% completion checklist trophy for Grand Theft Auto VI. Similar to past Rockstar masterpieces, this requires completing all core story missions, stranger strands, a required quota of stunt jumps and activities, finding major collectible sets (cards, WAiNK locations), winning races, discovering map areas, and acquiring properties. Monitor your in-game Stats page under Completion to track remaining requirements.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Accumulate a total of 250 completed stunts across Leonida. Stunts encompass billboard smashes, designated unique jump ramps, mid-air spins, and two-wheel driving maneuvers. Use high-speed sports cars or agile dirt bikes along highways and industrial docks to chain stunt completions quickly.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in every distinct mini-game activity available in Leonida at least once. Tracked activities include: 1) Top Fun Drone Racing, 2) Street/Off-road Racing, 3) Sport Fishing, 4) Arcade Games, 5) Shooting Range, 6) Bowling at Kolt & Associates, 7) Yoga/Meditation, 8) Scooter Bros Deliveries, and 9) Strip Club/Bar Lounge leisure. You only need to participate once, not achieve high scores.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve a gold medal rating across all 42 Shooting Range challenges in Ammu-Nation gun stores across the state. The challenges span multiple weapon categories: Pistols, Submachine Guns, Shotguns, Assault Rifles, and Precision Marksman Rifles. Aim for headshots, maintain rapid target transitions, and avoid hitting penalty civilian silhouettes.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Locate and win the Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 designated course locations across Vice City, Port Gellhorn, and the rural counties. Master tight roll and pitch controls, utilize speed boost rings, and memorize checkpoint sequences to beat the opponent ghost drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Secure 1st place in 20 distinct race events across Leonida. These include street sprint races through downtown Vice City, dirt rally circuits through the wetlands, and watercraft boat races along the eastern coast. Winning duplicate races does not count towards the 20 unique threshold.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Engage Cal in his coastal or swamp fishing mini-game and surpass his target catch weight or count. Cast near active fish ripples, gently reel when the line has slack, and avoid snapping the line by counter-steering against the fish's erratic tugs.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Visit any arcade lounge or bar cabinet in Leonida and play through an arcade title from start to final level or game over credit screen. Games like retro shmups or beat-'em-ups offer quick playthroughs. Fulfilling the winning win condition or final stage unlocks this bronze.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the entire Stranger & Freaks storyline for Andy, concluding with his final mission. Andy's strand explores recovery and chaotic misadventures in Vice City. Clear each marker as it appears on your map and do not leave his storyline unfinished before the story finale.

trophies.guide: Locate and interact with all 18 scenic meditation spots scattered throughout the wilderness, coastal cliffs, and serene rooftop sanctuaries across Leonida. Approach the meditation mat or viewpoint prompt, initiate the breathing session, and hold until the prompt completes.

trophies.guide: As part of Bret's hunting missions or outdoor requests, track down and harvest a designated legendary/unique wild animal in the Leonida backcountry or wetlands. Use scent maskers, crouch to avoid spooking the creature, and utilize a clean vital rifle shot.

trophies.guide: Find and collect all cards across 3 complete collectible card decks hidden around Leonida. Decks include vintage Vice City memorabilia, pin-ups, and legendary outlaws. Cards are found inside interiors, behind convenience counters, and at hidden roadside landmarks.

trophies.guide: Tag or interact with WAiNK graffiti / check-in stickers at 100 distinct designated locations throughout Leonida. Look for urban alleys, overpasses, transit stations, and beach pavilions. Keep track of visited zones via your in-game map filter.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 in-game ambient challenges. These encompass weapon headshot streaks, driving near-misses, high-speed evasion, wildlife photography, and tactical stealth takedowns. Review the Challenges menu in the pause screen to focus on easiest objectives.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With both Lucia and Jason together in free-roam or during a heist escape, trigger a 4-star Wanted Level by causing heavy mayhem or attacking state police outposts. Break line of sight with police cruisers and search helicopters, switch vehicles in secluded alleys, or hide in underground tunnels until the stars stop flashing.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, hold up three separate convenience stores or pharmacies in immediate succession while maintaining an active Wanted Level. Intimidate the clerk, grab the till cash, sprint into your getaway car, and speed directly to the next shop before the police cordon fully closes in.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Enter or scan 100 unique vehicle models across Leonida. GTA VI features sports cars, classic cruisers, airboats, pickups, delivery vans, motorcycles, and military hardware. Driving down Ocean Drive, Port Gellhorn docks, and airport parking lots rapidly builds your catalog.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Lucia or Jason's Combat Focus special ability during a heavy firefight with rival gang members or law enforcement. Target 5 distinct enemies with rapid headshots before the ability meter drains. Using a high-capacity pistol or rapid assault rifle simplifies this.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Breach the security perimeter at Vice City International Airport (VCIA), commandeer an aircraft (such as a private jet or commercial cargo turboprop), and take off smoothly from the runway while evading the instant airport trespassing wanted level.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A witty nod to classic GTA tank mayhem. Acquire a Rhino military tank (either through military base infiltration or high wanted level military response) and pilot it while causing explosive destruction, or endure sustained anti-armor heat until the trophy triggers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Execute a stealth burglary at a jewelry establishment. Cut alarms, avoid perimeter cameras, silently subdue or bypass security guards, glass-cut or loot display cases quietly, and slip away into the shadows without raising a general police alarm.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully breach and rob 5 bank vaults across the financial districts and commercial towns of Leonida, escaping the subsequent police pursuit with your score intact. Use thermite or drill gear on vault doors, pack the loot bags, and execute a planned getaway route.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept a Gruppe Sechs armored security van in transit. Block its path, blast open the reinforced rear doors using sticky explosives or shotgun breaching rounds, grab the cash cases, and evade the responding patrol units.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog of war across the entire map of Leonida by traveling through all 52 named districts, islands, wetlands, and mountain passes. Flying a helicopter or fast aircraft across grid corridors is the most efficient way to uncover all zones.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate and rob an illegal racket/stash operation belonging to each of the 9 criminal syndicates operating in Leonida (including Vice City cartels, biker gangs, local street outfits, and swamp smugglers). Neutralize the guards and loot the operational cash.
